title: Dual Port RAM System
text: Dual-port RAM that supports simultaneous read and write operations, 4 inputs, 2 outputs, {Type of RAM} sets RAM type Dual; {Use asynchronous read feature in target hardware} sets the option to enable asynchronous read feature in target, {Behavior for write output} sets the write output behavior, {Initial output of RAM} sets the initial simulation output of RAM, {Model RAM with one cycle of delay} and {Specify vector input access} sets the vector input access as serial. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Type of RAM
params.values: RAM type Dual port (default) | Simple dual port | Single port | True dual port | Simple tri port

params.name: Use asynchronous read feature in target hardware
params.values: Option to enable asynchronous read feature in target hardware off (default) | on

params.name: Behavior for write output
params.values: Write output behavior New data (default) | Old data

params.name: Initial output of RAM
params.values: Initial simulation output of RAM ’0.0’ (default) | Scalar | Vector

params.name: Model RAM with one cycle of delay
params.values: Model RAM with one cycle of delay on (default) | off

params.name: Specify vector input access
params.values: Specify vector input access as serial or parallel serial (default) | parallel
